title: Addition & Subtraction Word Problems Within 20
intro: Help your student connect an addition or subtraction story to an action.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Read one story aloud and act it out with counters. Ask the student to describe what changed before choosing the operation.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

At the start: 8 counters.

What changes: 5 counters are added.

What we need: the number of counters now.

8 + 5 = 13

Grace has 13 counters now.

Complete a group of 10

8 original + 2 new = 10

Keep the other 3

The 5 new counters are 2 + 3.

8 + 5 = 8 + 2 + 3 = 10 + 3 = 13

Ask your student

Did the collection grow, or were some counters taken away?

If your student needs help

If the operation is wrong, replay the action rather than relying on a keyword.
